claims: As of early April 2, 2026, the Artemis II Orion spacecraft is in a high Earth orbit.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft had a successful launch from Kennedy Space Center on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft has a crew of four.
As of early April 2, 2026, the crew of the Artemis II Orion spacecraft is safe.
As of early April 2, 2026, the crew of the Artemis II Orion spacecraft is preparing for a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft 10-day mission includes a 70-minute manual test-drive of the capsule before maneuvering toward the Moon.
As of early April 2, 2026, the crew of the Artemis II Orion spacecraft is performing system checks.
The system checks include solar array deployment.
The system checks include maneuvering tests.
A maneuver called translunar injection is planned for April 2, 2026.
The translunar injection maneuver sets the Artemis II Orion spacecraft on a path toward the Moon.
The crew of the Artemis II Orion spacecraft will travel around the Moon.
The crew of the Artemis II Orion spacecraft is expected to splash down on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft flight is testing the systems for future human missions to the lunar surface.
